title: GaussTrans: A Gaussian Interface Framework for Multi-Layer Refractive Transport
abstract: arXiv:2611.25950v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We investigate surface modeling of multi-transparent interfaces to achieve accurate light transmission. The interplay of errors in geometric structure, light paths, and observation results during the reconstruction of transparent media with a high number of layers makes this a challenging problem. Some existing techniques address the reconstruction of transparent scenes by reducing the number of layers or simplifying light paths; however, this limits their direct applicability to high-order transparent scenes. We propose GaussTrans, a compact framework for light transport in high-order transparent scenes, consisting of three components: Gaussian-Field Hybrid Surfaces, Transport-Coupled Refinement, and Primitive-Guided Implicit Intersection. Gaussian-Field Hybrid Surfaces use a hybrid approach combining Gauss surfaces and fields to reconstruct different interfaces. Transport-Coupled Refinement reduces coupling errors by evaluating the ent

translated_title: GaussTrans：一种用于多层折射传输的高斯界面框架
translated_abstract: 我们研究多层透明界面的表面建模，以实现精确的光传输。在重建具有大量层数的透明介质时，几何结构、光路与观测结果中的误差相互耦合，使这一问题极具挑战性。一些现有技术通过减少层数或简化光路来处理透明场景的重建，但这限制了它们在高阶透明场景中的直接适用性。我们提出GaussTrans，一个面向高阶透明场景光传输的紧凑框架，由三个组件构成：高斯-场混合表面、传输耦合细化以及基元引导的隐式求交。高斯-场混合表面采用结合高斯表面与场的混合方法来重建不同界面；传输耦合细化通过评估（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出GaussTrans框架，通过高斯-场混合表面、传输耦合细化和基元引导隐式求交三个组件，实现高阶多层透明场景中精确的光传输与重建。
en_tdlr: GaussTrans is a compact framework combining Gaussian-field hybrid surfaces, transport-coupled refinement, and primitive-guided implicit intersection to achieve accurate light transport in high-order multi-layer transparent scenes.
